name: Dredge
fantasy: The harbour hauler. Reels you in on a rope, drops an anchor on you, and grows with every knock.
silhouette: the round brass helm and the rope drum on one shoulder

card.loop: Brawler who reels you in: hook a foe to your feet, smash them, finish them up close.

weapons.shotgun: Seven slugs in a tight fan that stop 6m out, a shot every half second. Hits from behind hurt more.

card.rmb: Throw a rope-hook over rocks at the first foe and reel them to your feet, stunned. Strafe to swing them.
card.e: Hop forward and drop the anchor in front of you: damage and a long stun. In the air you smash straight down.
card.dash: A short shoulder barge toward the cursor, further in the air. It works while you reel.
card.passive: Salvage: knocks and assists add health, up to 10 stacks. A knock heals you.
card.x: Ultimate (X, level 6): plant and charge a fan, then two waves of heavy brass slugs with Anti-Heal.

passive.name: Salvage
passive.desc: Each knock or assist adds a Salvage stack (+2.5% health, 10 at most); being downed costs one. Hits on a hunter's back deal 50% more. Knocking a hunter heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Barge
dash.desc: A 4.6m shoulder barge toward the cursor (2 charges): a burst where you set off, and it shoves foes along it for 5. In the air it goes 35% further. It is usable while reeling someone in. Just after the Anchor your turn is limited to 35 degrees.

variants.tap: Throw a rope-hook 11.5m over rocks and props to the first foe (a cliff face stops it). The foe is reeled to you, stunned, dragged over rocks (until it arrives or 3s pass), and lands Grounded for 1s; strafe and the body swings round you. You are Grounded while you reel (no jump or glide; the barge still works). It also pulls an ally to safety and scoops up wisps on the way. The abyss takes whoever is pulled over it.

e.name: Anchor Drop
e.desc: Hop a body length forward (0.38s), then the anchor smashes down in a 3m cone: 25 damage, stun 1.1s, slammed to the ground and Grounded. In the air you smash straight down and the anchor lands with you: a 3.2m ring, up to +50% damage by height. Over the abyss it slams where you are instead.

x.name: Brass Broadside
x.desc: Plant your feet and charge for 1.1s while a 105 degree fan grows on the ground ahead (everyone sees it: it is the exact area). Then two waves 0.6s apart, six heavy brass slugs each, out to 5.9m: 5 damage a slug and Anti-Heal for 3s. Up close every slug lands. A stun during the charge stops it (back in 8s). 21s.

rank3.dash: pellet hits trim 0.25s off the barge recharge
rank3.sec: hitting a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown
rank3.kin: the air smash: up to +75% damage by height

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 12s -> 9.6s; hitting a foe refunds 33% of it.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 10s -> 7s; pellet hits trim 0.25s off the recharge.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 5.6s, damage +30%; the air smash adds up to +75% damage by height.

tells.half: brass glints along the shoulder drum from 5 stacks
tells.full: 10 stacks: a brass halo ring at the feet and a bell within 20m
